items.title: Layoffs, Cyber Disruptions, Annex 1 Upgrades Might Change The Case For Investing In West (WST)
items.summary: West Pharmaceutical Services recently announced it will phase out a product line at its Scottsdale facility by the end of September, resulting in 98 layoffs and related manufacturing work being shifted to other Becton, Dickinson and Co. locations. At the same time, the company’s push into higher-value products and Annex 1-related sterility upgrades is being tempered by cyber incident disruptions in its West Vantage segment and tariff- and commodity-driven cost pressures.
